title: SpaceX, Tesla Boards Study Possible $3.5 Trillion Merger
summary: Elon Musk openly endorsed the prospect of combining SpaceX with Tesla  in what would be the biggest-ever corporate merger. Ed Ludlow has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Blackstone Nears Deal to Lease London Office to Fast-Growing Fintech Stripe
summary: Stripe LLC is close to signing a lease to take space at a London office owned by Blackstone Inc, as the company seeks to accommodate its rapid expansion.

title: Anson Funds Bets on AI Activism
summary: Anson Funds is preparing to launch an activist fund targeting small and mid-cap tech, media, and telecom companies. Portfolio manager Sagar Gupta joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why he sees AI as a catalyst for growth. He also discusses Lionsgate's valuable content library and potential strategic interest. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AT&T Boosts Profit Outlook But SpaceX Threat Weighs on Stock
summary: AT&T Inc. showed strong gains in internet and mobile phone customers in the third quarter, but it wasn’t enough to assuage market concerns about the looming entry of SpaceX into the consumer cellular market.

title: EBay to Cut 9% of Staff in Second Round of Job Cuts This Year
summary: EBay Inc. will eliminate 9% of its workforce, according to a person familiar with the matter, marking the company’s second round of job cuts this year.

title: DayOne Said to Weigh Options for IPO After Data Center Rout
summary: DayOne Data Centers Ltd. is weighing options for its US initial public offering, including a potential delay or size cut, as volatility around data centers increases, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Whop's Sequoia-Led Funding Pushes Its Value to $5.1 Billion
summary: “Rule one of making money is go where they ain’t.” That’s how famed investor Doug Leone, who used to run venture firm   Sequoia Capital, described his first deal at the firm since returning to an active investing role earlier this year.

title: Legal AI Startup Legora Raises Funds at $8.8 Billion Valuation
summary: Legora has raised $550 million in a funding round that will give the Swedish legal artificial intelligence startup an $8.8 billion post-money valuation and allow it to expand to new markets.

title: Navy Halts New Orders of Aevex Drone Boats Over Performance
summary: The US Navy will no longer buy a highly prized — but ultimately troubled — drone speedboat manufactured by Aevex Corp.’s BlackSea after already spending more than $130 million on the technology, according to people briefed on the matter.

title: Super Micro Jumps After Preliminary Results Top Estimates
summary: Shares of Super Micro Computer Inc. jumped after the company reported preliminary quarterly results that topped analysts’ estimates.

title: Turkey’s Vestel Looks to Revamp Business Amid Bond Restructuring
summary: Turkish electronics and appliance maker Vestel Elektronik expects the pressures that forced it into one of the country’s largest corporate Eurobond restructurings to persist, pushing it to rethink its business.

title: Meta Earnings Will Provide a Gut Check for Struggling AI Trade
summary: Meta Platforms Inc.’s earnings arrive as investors grow anxious about the state of the artificial intelligence trade, offering a chance to calm a few nerves — or exacerbate those fears.

title: Governments Take Websites Offline After PHP Security Warnings
summary: Governments in Europe are taking websites offline in response to warnings about critical security vulnerabilities in a programming language that underpins the internet.

title: Huang Says All Industries Across Europe Need to Adopt AI
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang pushed Europe to adopt artificial intelligence more quickly. “For Europe to benefit from AI, and to have really created an AI ecosystem and AI economy, you need all of the end markets, the end industries to adopt AI,” Huang said Wednesday at his company’s GTC conference in Berlin. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bernard Mensah on AI, Bond Yields and Global Markets
summary: Bernard Mensah of Bank of America discusses the AI bubble debate, rising sovereign bond yields and shifting global investment opportunities. He also examines supply chains, Europe’s growth challenges and opportunities across Asia and other global markets. Mensah spoke with Bloomberg at the Berlin Global Dialogue. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia CEO Huang Pushes Europe on All Industries Adopting AI
summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang pushed Europe to adopt artificial intelligence more quickly, striking a bullish note as some investors grow more skeptical about the sums being poured into the infrastructure underpinning the technology.

title: Finland Takes Down Websites as Precaution Due to Vulnerabilities
summary: Finland started pulling government websites offline on Wednesday as a precaution after critical vulnerabilities were identified with no fixes immediately available.

title: Kallum Pickering Warns of AI Boom Bust Risks
summary: Kallum Pickering of Peel Hunt warns that high interest rates and heavy AI investment are concentrating capital and increasing boom bust risks. He discusses Fed policy, US debt, the AI race with China and why he expects inflation to move decisively lower next year. Pickering spoke on Bloomberg Brief. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: SpaceX-Tesla Combination ‘Extremely Tangible,’ Ferragu Says
summary: Pierre Ferragu, managing director at New Street Research, examines the prospect of combining SpaceX with Tesla Inc. Elon Musk openly endorsed the idea Tuesday, saying the boards of both companies had formed special committees of independent directors to consider the proposal. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Backlash Hits Home for Member of Congress in Virginia’s ‘Data Center Alley’
summary: House member seeks balanced growth approach while calling industry ‘tone-deaf’
